questions.question: Name the six kinds of angles in order from smallest to biggest.
questions.expected_answer: Acute, right, obtuse, straight, reflex and revolution.

questions.question: Explain why an angle does not get bigger when you make its arms longer.
questions.expected_answer: An angle measures the amount of turn between its arms, not the length of the arms. Longer arms with the same opening show the same amount of turn.

questions.question: Describe the angles inside an L-shaped hexagon.
questions.expected_answer: It has five right angles and one reflex angle. The reflex angle is at the inside corner, where the shape turns in.
